event: There is a funeral on Delmar. Most of the block goes. Some people who should be there are not.

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: Counting money behind till
thought: Every second feels like a countdown

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: On the phone, listening intently
thought: I can't let them see me fall

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: Filing paperwork, eyes flicking to the phone
thought: Justice is a heavy hand

name: Booker Lyle
action: Restocking shelves, glancing at the clock
thought: The market waits for no one

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: On the phone, fingers tapping rhythmically
thought: Truth hides in plain sight

name: Malik Reyes
action: Sitting alone, eyes on the floor
thought: I need to prove myself before I'm forgotten

name: Chidi Okonkwo
action: On the phone, jaw clenched
thought: I wish my brother trusted me

name: Cass Deveaux
action: Watching the road, shoulders squared
thought: Patience is my shield

name: Rey Vasquez
action: Behind the till, counting change
thought: Family is the only thing I can protect

event: Malik Reyes finds the count is short again. Not by much. Enough.

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: Stares blankly at the rain streaking down the laundromat window.
thought: The walls are closing in and every stranger looks like a ghost.

name: Malik Reyes
action: Kicks a stray pebble across the wet concrete of the terrace.
thought: Short again. He is going to tear my head off for this.

name: Booker Lyle
action: Counts the stack of bills twice, smoothing the corners down.
thought: Everyone has a price, and I am going to find yours today.

speech.text: Keep your voice down, Wes. Someone's always listening.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: Fingers the edge of a property deed while pretending to browse.
thought: This block is rotting from the inside out and nobody cares.

speech.text: You look like you're about to jump out of your skin, Officer.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: Scratches the back of his neck, avoiding eye contact with the shelves.
thought: If Deveaux asks one more question, I am walking right out.

speech.text: Just keeping an eye on things. That's my job.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: Slams a heavy metal drawer shut on a stack of incident reports.
thought: Lyle thinks he is untouchable, but paper trails never lie.

speech.text: This department is a joke and we both know it.

name: Ms. Ivy Calloway
action: Signs her name firmly on the delivery manifest with a worn pen.
thought: These outsiders think they can buy the block out from under us.

speech.text: You buying something, Mr. Deveaux, or just killing time?

name: Rey Vasquez
action: Wipes a greasy rag across his forearm, watching the street.
thought: Okonkwo is finished, and I need to make sure my doors stay shut.

name: Simone Adeyemi
action: Turns a medical chart page, her eyes heavy with exhaustion.
thought: Another rainy day bringing in people who should have stayed home.

speech.text: We are running low on gauze again.

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: waiting at bar
thought: I need to finish the escape plan tonight

speech.text: We’re not your friends.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: talking over the table
thought: I keep my edge

speech.text: You think I'm on your side?

name: Malik Reyes
action: sitting, listening
thought: I want the truth

speech.text: Find the truth, man.

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: calming the room
thought: Let Amara take over

speech.text: Stay calm, kid.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: sitting, waiting
thought: Bring Lyle to justice

speech.text: We need Lyle now.

name: Booker Lyle
action: sitting, negotiating
thought: Corner the market

speech.text: You’re not getting in my way.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: browsing shelves
thought: Protect myself

speech.text: I’m not your target.

name: Rey Vasquez
action: sitting, holding his wrench
thought: Protect my family

speech.text: We’ve got this.

name: Amara Bello
action: sitting, plotting
thought: Open my own shop

speech.text: Let me run it.

event: There is a funeral on Delmar. Most of the block goes. Some people who should be there are not.

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: Stares at the frost on the window, counting breaths.
thought: The door will rattle before the hour is through and we are still here.

speech.text: Get your coat on, Ma. We are leaving now.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: Twitches in his sleep, hands flat against the blanket.
thought: I left the ledger in the glove box.

name: Rey Vasquez
action: Turns heavily away from the cold glass, eyes shut tight.
thought: Nobody comes down this alley after midnight unless they want trouble.

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: Rolls over on the narrow cot, listening to the sleet.
thought: The file is sitting on my desk and it is missing three pages.

name: Adaeze Okonkwo
action: Keeps her eyes closed in the dark, fingers moving on the beads.
thought: He has never learned how to stop running from his own shadow.

speech.text: I am staying right here where my people are buried.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: Taps a fingernail against the wood of the empty table.
thought: The names on the deeds mean nothing once the snow covers the lot.

speech.text: Keep your voice down, Dot. The walls have ears tonight.

name: Malik Reyes
action: Shivers against the brick wall, watching the empty street.
thought: My toes are numb and nobody is coming out in this weather.

name: Gus Petrakis
action: Snorts softly in his armchair, TV humming to the empty room.
thought: Thirty years of flour on these floors and still the drafts get in.

speech.text: Turn that light off, Brady. Let the room go dark.

name: Tariq 'Tee' Bello
action: Breathes slow in the dark, arm draped over the blanket.
thought: The chairs will be waiting in the morning whether I am there or not.

speech.text: Go back to sleep, kid. It's just the wind.

name: Adaeze Okonkwo
belief: My home is no longer safe while Dez brings his desperation inside my kitchen.

name: Dez Okonkwo
belief: They are closing in, and time has finally run out for me on this block.

headline: Block Turns Out for Delmar Funeral

event: The block loses power for six hours. Everything happens in the dark.

name: Dez Okonkwo
action: Signs for the delivery while watching the empty street.
thought: A stranger asked about the ninth and I knew the net was finally closing.

name: Ofc. Brady Kohl
action: Reads the incident file while the phone rings.
thought: The ink on this report blurs every time I look at it.

speech.text: You going to answer that or just let it ring?

name: Det. Yolanda Ruiz
action: Listens to the receiver, pressing it hard to her ear.
thought: Every lead on this desk goes cold before the sun even hits.

speech.text: Leave it. It is just another ghost.

name: Booker Lyle
action: Counts small bills behind the glass counter.
thought: Everyone has a price, and I can still buy my way out of this.

speech.text: Check the back lock before you step out.

name: Nadia Vasquez
action: Sorts attendance sheets with sharp movements.
thought: They think nobody sees them whispering in the back corners.

speech.text: Sit down and keep your voice under control.

name: Malik Reyes
action: Sits on the concrete step, rubbing his aching hands.
thought: People only come for me when they want to squeeze me dry.

name: Tiny Reyes
action: Flips through a colored folder, swinging her legs.
thought: The grown-ups are pretending they are not scared of the dark.

speech.text: I was just looking at the pictures.

name: Cass Deveaux
action: Stands near the edge of the lot, checking a clipboard.
thought: Everything on this block has a price if you wait long enough.

name: Rey Vasquez
action: Wipes greasy fingers on a rag behind the counter.
thought: If Dez comes back around here, I will not hesitate this time.
